acquisition: Browser rendered quarterly Income table, expanded GHO Earnings, GHO, Incentives, Staking, Insurance and Methodology. All USD values below are displayed rounded figures; dash preserved as null, not zero.

methodology.ghoBorrowFees: Published methodology says interest earned from GHO borrowers across all Aave V3 markets, accrual method, accruing hourly based on GHO borrow rates. Current implementation not independently audited; historical realized/unrealized caveat at governance post remains relevant.
methodology.facilitatorDepositYield: Published methodology: accrued hourly from aGHO the Core, Prime and Horizon facilitators minted and deposited in associated Aave V3 reserves, using direct-mint aGHO balances and prevailing liquidity rate.
methodology.gsmInterest: Hourly accrual based on aToken balance in GSM and liquidity rate.
methodology.ghoLiquidity: GHO tokens sent from Protocol to provide liquidity across destinations. Token-transfer-time recognition and price; may include recoverable principal. Do NOT assume entire transfer is irrecoverable incentive expense.
methodology.sGhoMerit: Methodology calls this sGHO (Merit): cost captured when Protocol sends funds to ACI for distribution, at transaction-time price. Table actual label is sGHO. It is NOT total actual paid-out GHO Merit rewards; other incentive lines may contain additional GHO, and label clearly does not reconcile to ACI's $12M annual 2025 budget.
methodology.ghoCex: GHO sent to exchanges/MMs for listings, captured when transferred. Cannot infer all transfers are incentive expense rather than market-making principal.
methodology.stkGho: AAVE emissions accrued over active days, using contemporaneous AAVE price. GHO-specific but paid in AAVE, shown separately to preserve user's scope decision.
methodology.umbrella: All protection pools, allowance spread daily; GHO-specific allocation unavailable in this table.
methodology.meritOther: ACI Distributed Incentives and Merkl Campaign Rewards are protocol-wide/all-assets, cannot assign entirely to GHO.

exportAvailability: UI historical download requires sign-in. Documented https://api.tokenlogic.xyz/v1/aave/revenue/quarterly?from=2023-07-01&to=2026-09-05 returned unauthorized. Exact unrounded figures not retrieved.
confidence: High confidence transcription from primary provider UI; medium confidence accounting categorization; low confidence completeness and reconciliation for user-specific strict P&L.
netIncomeStatus: Do not compute a definitive net from these rows: incentive attribution, discount subsidy, bad debt and GSM costs incomplete; some transfer categories may include principal; source table/chart discrepancies require reconciliation.
